detector_contract.baseline_mode: Every baseline path must exist and match sha256; any missing path or byte drift is red.
detector_contract.migration_mode: Candidate inventory_version and every changed file_version increment by exactly one; candidate hashes match disk; the exact change set is covered by one record with executed clean up/down, byte-identical reverse, idempotent up, and native version bump when present. executed_up/executed_down booleans are not trusted.

versioned_migration_procedure.name: quiesce-and-identify
versioned_migration_procedure.requirement: Stop admitting new workers. Record the active campaign id, inventory version, and activation commit; in-flight workers either finish entirely on the old version or are archived as aborted and restarted. Never mix versions.

versioned_migration_procedure.name: preserve-baseline
versioned_migration_procedure.requirement: Keep the vN inventory immutable. Create a vN+1 candidate; do not overwrite the old hash manifest or its migration evidence.

versioned_migration_procedure.name: declare-change-set
versioned_migration_procedure.requirement: List every changed frozen path with before/after sha256 and increment each changed file_version by exactly one; unchanged entries retain their version.

versioned_migration_procedure.name: bump-contract-versions
versioned_migration_procedure.requirement: Increment inventory_version by exactly one. Also bump the artifact's native version carrier when it has one: WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.schema_version, schema $id/schema_version, or the launcher/prompt contract version recorded by the inventory.

versioned_migration_procedure.name: author-migration
versioned_migration_procedure.requirement: Add one numbered migration record vN-to-vN+1 naming the exact paths, versions, and hashes plus executable up and down steps. Missing down is a hard rejection.

versioned_migration_procedure.name: execute-forward
versioned_migration_procedure.requirement: Run up on a scratch copy of real vN catalog, queue, prompt, and persisted receipt data; read the vN+1 bytes back from disk and validate them with the vN+1 schemas.

versioned_migration_procedure.name: execute-reverse-and-idempotency
versioned_migration_procedure.requirement: Run down and require a byte-identical vN hash census, then run up twice and require the second application to make no further byte change.

versioned_migration_procedure.name: run-gates-and-review
versioned_migration_procedure.requirement: Run schema/catalog/resolver tests, launcher smoke tests, and freeze_check in both states; obtain the catalog-required fresh independent review.

versioned_migration_procedure.name: activate-atomically
versioned_migration_procedure.requirement: Atomically publish vN+1 and record activation commit SHA plus UTC timestamp. New launches must carry inventory_version and inventory sha256 in their run record.

versioned_migration_procedure.name: retain-rollback
versioned_migration_procedure.requirement: Retain vN, the down step, and partial-run artifacts until every vN+1 consumer has completed; rollback means executing down and reactivating vN, never editing the active manifest in place.
